en_ops.new: When He shows up, it’s gonna be amazing. People who were blind will be able to see, and those who were deaf will hear everything. People who couldn't walk will be jumping around like deer, and those who couldn't speak will be singing their hearts out. Water will start flowing in the driest places, turning hot sand into a cool, refreshing oasis, and thirsty ground into a splashing fountain. Even the wild animals will have plenty to drink, and the dead grasslands will become super lush.
